feedback: The confession follows the route I inferred: an unpowered camera makes the claimed feed false, and the preview plus private glass provide a feasible poisoning path. It adds the explicit poison-taking and dosing acts, but those are admissions of the proposed method rather than a new forensic mechanism. Elon's shame about selling an unfinished demonstration was already established, so the emotional explanation feels earned. Elle and Monet accepting the consequences of their financial lies also give the ending weight. Still, the confession confirms one plausible reconstruction more than it resolves an otherwise unique deduction. I would have accepted an innocent Elon confession about his failed demo just as readily. The ending is coherent and satisfying dramatically, while the pre-vote certainty remains limited.
